exposure: Knowledge of early essential newborn care
outcome: Knowledge of early essential newborn care
Perceived difficulties and concerns regarding skin-to-skin contact
cohort: 204 health professionals from obstetrics, anaesthesiology, and neonatology departments in a tertiary hospital in Central Vietnam
finding: The study found that knowledge of early essential newborn care was lowest among anaesthesiology staff, while the perceived frequency and difficulties of implementing skin-to-skin contact varied among health professional groups.
